<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Order a New Vending Machine">15de1ff2832803102b2be5e0deaad30c</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:9e217eab83ac47102b2be5e0deaad3e5</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Feature Select</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || !newValue) return;

   var total = parseInt(g_form.getValue('base_price')) || 0;

   var selected = newValue.split(',');

   selected.forEach(function(value) {
      var option = g_form.getOption('features', value);

      if (option) {
         var price = option.getAttribute('price'); 
         if (price) {
            total += parseInt(price);
         }
      }
   });

   g_form.setValue('total_price', total);
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-06 10:59:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1221cebb83e4c7102b2be5e0deaad369</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Feature Select</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="4Dot Machine Service" source="x_2005341_4dot_m_0">4be6219f839c43102b2be5e0deaad37b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="4Dot Machine Service">4be6219f839c43102b2be5e0deaad37b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_1221cebb83e4c7102b2be5e0deaad369</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-06 11:02:03</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
